description: Splits average response time per API into backend time and gateway mediation time, with backend p95. Use to tell whether slowness comes from the backend service or from the gateway.

configuration.query: FROM apim_event_response | WHERE DATE_DIFF("minute", requestTimestamp, NOW()) <= ?lookback_minutes | STATS calls=COUNT(*), avg_total_ms=AVG(responseLatency), avg_backend_ms=AVG(backendLatency), backend_p95_ms=PERCENTILE(backendLatency, 95), avg_gateway_ms=AVG(requestMediationLatency + responseMediationLatency) BY apiName | EVAL avg_total_ms=ROUND(avg_total_ms, 1), avg_backend_ms=ROUND(avg_backend_ms, 1), backend_p95_ms=ROUND(backend_p95_ms), avg_gateway_ms=ROUND(avg_gateway_ms, 1) | SORT avg_backend_ms DESC

lookback_minutes.description: How far back to look, in minutes (e.g. 60 for the last hour, 1440 for a day).
